items.comments: Had a great time at Alden's place. Right across the street from the college, really nice view also. Super convenient location, and Alden was a great host.

Alden was such a lovely host - she is an undergrad at UW and is very friendly, interested in getting to know me, and offered plenty of recommendations for activities, food, coffee, transportation, etc. She was easy to communicate with and very responsive. The bed is comfortable, in a closet with just a few feet of space around it, but you have access to the entire apartment. If you're looking for a place that's for lounging and very spacious, spick and span, etc. then this might not be the best place, but if you want to be near UW in a cute building and with a friendly host then it's great!
she is very nice .but  the room is a little bit small for couple.
Amazing Host! Made us feel very welcome, and accommodated to our requests very well. The price was more than reasonable as well for the location and space. Definitely would recommend her to anyone!
